+def make_context(cafile=None, cadata=None, ciphers=None, validate_certs=True):
+    """Build the TLS context used for both validation and HTTPS requests."""
+    if ciphers is not None:
+        if isinstance(ciphers, string_types):
+            cipher_string = ciphers
+        elif isinstance(ciphers, (list, tuple)) and ciphers and all(isinstance(value, string_types) and value for value in ciphers):

+        else:
+            raise ValueError('ciphers must be a non-empty OpenSSL cipher string or a non-empty list of cipher strings')
+        if not cipher_string:
+            raise ValueError('ciphers must be a non-empty OpenSSL cipher string or a non-empty list of cipher strings')
+
+    if HAS_SSLCONTEXT:
+        if validate_certs:
+            context = create_default_context(cafile=cafile)
+        else:
+            context = SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_SSLv23)
+            if ssl.OP_NO_SSLv2:
+                context.options |= ssl.OP_NO_SSLv2
+            context.options |= ssl.OP_NO_SSLv3

+            context.verify_mode = ssl.CERT_NONE

+        raise NotImplementedError('Host libraries are too old to support creating an sslcontext')
+
+    if validate_certs and (cafile or cadata):
+        context.load_verify_locations(cafile=cafile, cadata=cadata or None)
+    if ciphers is not None:
+        try:
+            context.set_ciphers(cipher_string)
+        except (ValueError, TypeError, UnicodeError, ssl.SSLError):
+            raise ValueError('Invalid or unsupported TLS ciphers')
+    return context

diff --git a/test/units/module_utils/urls/test_ciphers.py b/test/units/module_utils/urls/test_ciphers.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..d5f8ec8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/units/module_utils/urls/test_ciphers.py
@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+
+import ssl
+
+import pytest
+
+from ansible.module_utils.urls import HTTPSClientAuthHandler, Request, make_context
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('cipher_spec', [
+    'ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256',
+    ['ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256', 'ECDHE-RSA-AES256-SHA384'],
+])
+def test_make_context_accepts_cipher_string_and_list(cipher_spec):
+    context = make_context(ciphers=cipher_spec)
+    names = [cipher['name'] for cipher in context.get_ciphers()]
+    assert 'ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256' in names
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('cipher_spec', [[], ['AES', 3], 3, '', 'NO-SUCH-CIPHER'])
+def test_make_context_rejects_invalid_ciphers(cipher_spec):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='ciphers'):
+        make_context(ciphers=cipher_spec)
+
+
+def test_make_context_without_validation_keeps_protocol_options():
+    context = make_context(ciphers='ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256', validate_certs=False)
+    assert context.verify_mode == ssl.CERT_NONE
+    assert context.options & ssl.OP_NO_SSLv3
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('url,unix_socket', [
+    ('https://ansible.com/', None),
+    ('http://ansible.com/', None),
+    ('https://ansible.com/', '/tmp/ansible-test.sock'),
+])
+def test_request_reuses_cipher_context_for_https_and_redirects(mocker, url, unix_socket):
+    mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.urls.urllib_request.urlopen')
+    opener = mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.urls.urllib_request.install_opener')
+    Request().open('GET', url, ciphers='ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256', unix_socket=unix_socket)
+    handlers = opener.call_args[0][0].handlers
+    https_handlers = [h for h in handlers if isinstance(h, HTTPSClientAuthHandler)]
+    assert len(https_handlers) == 1
+    assert any(c['name'] == 'ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256' for c in https_handlers[0]._context.get_ciphers())
